original_target.title: The factor-two integrality gap for asymmetric metric routing

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original all directed metrics asks OPT<=2 Held-Karp with degree1 and outgoing cuts>=1. Vygen current Theorem1 gives9+alpha for alpha>3+2sqrt2, hence12+2sqrt2 upper gap, not2. New Palomar KKO/Christofides claims use undirected symmetric metrics; small ATSP enumeration and exact random instances do not cover arbitrary directed costs. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
